scholarships.title: University of Otago International Academic Excellence Scholarships

existing.funding_period: across the first three years of the degree
existing.description: The University of Otago International Academic Excellence Scholarships are awarded to high achieving international students who have studied overseas and will be commencing a full-time Bachelor degree at Otago, with a total value of approximately NZD $35,000 made up of a first-year residential college accommodation scholarship and tuition scholarships in the second and third years. The scholarship is invitation-based: applicants are invited to apply in eVision only after they have accepted a previous scholarship offer such as the Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship for International Students or a Global Scholarship, and must complete the scholarship application questions as requested. It is a competitive selection award and is subject to the standard Undergraduate Entrance Scholarship terms and conditions except where superseded.
eligibility: Be an international student who has studied overseas
Be commencing a full-time Bachelor degree at the University of Otago
Have accepted a previous University of Otago international scholarship offer, such as the Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship for International Students or the Global Scholarship
Respond to an invitation to apply in eVision and complete the scholarship application questions and information as requested
existing.eligibility_summary: High achieving international students who have studied overseas and will be commencing a full-time Bachelor degree at the University of Otago. Applicants are invited to apply in eVision only after accepting a previous scholarship offer, and must complete the scholarship application questions.
benefits: Tuition fee scholarship in years two and three
coverage: First-year accommodation scholarship in a University residential college
Tuition scholarship in the second and third years of the degree
requirements: Accept a previous University of Otago international scholarship offer to receive the invitation
Apply through eVision in response to the invitation
Complete the scholarship application questions and information as requested
documents: eVision scholarship application questions completed in response to the invitation
Evidence of prior study and admission to a full-time Bachelor degree, assessed through the admission and scholarship process
existing.english_requirement: Not stated on the official page read; English language proficiency is assessed through admission to the programme.
application_method: Invitation only: applicants are invited to apply in eVision after accepting a previous scholarship offer
Complete the scholarship application questions and information as requested; this is a competitive selection scholarship
existing.selection_notes: The official page describes this as a competitive selection scholarship. The University of Otago International Academic Excellence Scholarship is an Entrance Scholarship and is subject to the standard Undergraduate Entrance Scholarship terms and conditions, except where superseded by the specific terms of this award.
existing.best_fit: High-achieving international students who already hold an offer of a University of Otago international entrance scholarship and are prepared to complete a competitive supplementary application in eVision.
existing.duration: Spans first year accommodation plus tuition scholarship in the second and third years
existing.application_period: Invitation-based, following acceptance of an earlier Otago international scholarship offer during admission processing
existing.deadline_display: Invited to apply in eVision, after you have accepted any previous scholarship offer (e.g. Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship, Global Scholarship). Required to complete scholarship application questions and information as requested.
existing.program_type: Undergraduate competitive selection scholarship (accommodation and tuition fees)

scholarships.title: VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship
scholarships.official_source: Te Herenga Waka — Victoria University of Wellington

existing.description: The VUW Postgraduate International Scholarship is a partial fee-based scholarship of NZ$10,000 towards tuition fees for new international students entering a Master's degree programme of 120, 180 or 240 points, or a 120-point Postgraduate Diploma, at Te Herenga Waka — Victoria University of Wellington. No separate scholarship application is required: eligibility is assessed when the student applies for their programme, and the outcome is communicated in the Offer of Place. The scholarship applies for one year of study only, is credited directly against tuition fees upfront, and is awarded formally once the student enrols in first-year courses. It may be held alongside other scholarships where their regulations allow, and deferral is possible within the same calendar year but not to a later year.
eligibility: Be an international student paying full international fees
Intend to attain a Master's degree at Victoria University of Wellington of 120, 180 or 240 points, or a Postgraduate Diploma of 120 points
Hold an unconditional or conditional Offer of Place for a Master's degree programme or Postgraduate Diploma at Victoria University of Wellington
Be a new student to a Victoria University of Wellington Postgraduate Diploma or Master's degree programme
Not be already studying at Victoria University of Wellington as a returning student, unless undertaking the University's EAP or Bachelor's degree programme
Not be a Study Abroad, Exchange or Twinning student from an overseas partner university
Not have received credit transfer, advanced standing or recognition of prior learning from a previous qualification
Not be sponsored by their home government or the New Zealand government
Not be an Australian or New Zealand citizen, permanent resident, resident visa holder, or hold a diplomatic visa entitling them to domestic status
existing.eligibility_summary: International students paying full international fees who hold an unconditional or conditional Offer of Place for a Master's degree programme of 120, 180 or 240 points, or a Postgraduate Diploma of 120 points, and who are new to the postgraduate programme. The scholarship is open to students completing or recently completing Victoria's EAP programme or a Victoria bachelor's degree, but not to returning students, Study Abroad or Exchange students, students with credit transfer or advanced standing, government sponsored students, or Australian and New Zealand citizens, permanent residents, resident visa holders and diplomatic visa holders.
benefits: NZ$10,000 tuition fee credit applied directly to tuition fees upfront, so students pay the reduced amount to the University
Applies for one year of study only, for the student's first enrolment in the programme
May be held in conjunction with other scholarships where the other scholarship's regulations permit
Recipients may request approval to defer the scholarship to another intake within the same calendar year
coverage: NZ$10,000 credited towards tuition fees only, for one year of study
requirements: Apply for a Master's degree programme of 120, 180 or 240 points or a Postgraduate Diploma of 120 points and hold an Offer of Place
Enrol in first-year courses, which is when the scholarship is formally awarded
documents: Application for the relevant Master's degree or Postgraduate Diploma programme, through which eligibility is assessed
Evidence of international fee status and of the Offer of Place, held by the University
existing.english_requirement: Not stated as a separate scholarship requirement; students completing Victoria's English for Academic Purposes (EAP) programme are explicitly eligible for the scholarship.
application_method: No separate scholarship application: students are assessed for scholarship eligibility on application for their programme
Recipients are advised in their Offer of Place if the scholarship has been offered
existing.selection_notes: Holders must demonstrate their academic potential, as demonstrated by their admission into a Victoria University of Wellington Master's or Postgraduate Diploma degree programme. There is no separate competitive selection round described on the official page; eligibility is assessed through admission.
existing.best_fit: New international students entering a full-time on-campus Master's degree or 120-point Postgraduate Diploma at Victoria University of Wellington who are paying full international fees.
existing.duration: One year of study only, for a student's first enrolment in the programme
existing.application_period: Aligned with programme applications; there is no separate scholarship application window and the outcome is communicated in the applicant's Offer of Place
existing.deadline_display: Closing date(s): Same as the programme application closing date. A scholarship application is not required; students are assessed for eligibility on application for their programme.
existing.program_type: Partial tuition fee scholarship for new international postgraduate students
